source.title: An experimental study of the emergence of human communication systems

confidence_rationale: Foundational, well-replicated paradigm (experimental semiotics) whose manipulation is an unusually close match to ARC-101's enabling-condition list: shared task, separated partners, coordination pressure, and a channel engineered to exclude pre-existing symbols. Mapping fidelity is the strength here (0.80). Held below 0.8 because the participants are language-possessing adults, so the design demonstrates a grammar-free CHANNEL rather than a grammar-free agent, and because what emerges is a sign system plus coordination procedures, not syntax.
failure_signatures: An adult dyad with full prior language can invent a working sign system in minutes, so success in this paradigm cannot discriminate 'the social ecology bootstraps language' from 'existing linguistic competence is redeployed through a novel channel'.
The emergent systems were lexical and procedural, not syntactic, so the paradigm gives no purchase on whether the same ecology would also produce recursive structure.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Pairs of adults, physically separated and prevented from using standard symbols such as letters, rapidly invented novel graphic communication systems in order to solve a shared video-game task. The emergent systems integrated explicit signs with information implicitly available to both players and with silent behaviour-coordinating procedures, and sign forms converged on economical, perceptually distinguishable, easily produced and variation-tolerant shapes.
mapping.ree_translation: This is the closest human-laboratory realisation of ARC-101's enabling-condition set -- shared attention on a common task, partial observability of the partner, coordination pressure, and a low-cost channel deliberately stripped of inherited grammar. Under exactly those conditions a communication system does bootstrap, and it bootstraps from grounded joint activity rather than from any grammatical scaffold. That is ARC-101's directional bet about where the bootstrap force comes from.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Participants already possess full natural language and can reason explicitly about signalling, so the study removes the grammar from the CHANNEL, not from the MINDS. It therefore cannot establish that ecology alone suffices in an agent with no prior language, which is precisely the work REE's V5 social ecology would have to do. The output is a sign inventory plus coordination routines, so the result speaks to ARC-101's 'engine' half and is silent on the 'turbocharger' half.
mapping.source_context: Laboratory dyadic coordination game; adult human participants; novel graphic signalling channel engineered to prevent the use of conventional orthographic symbols.

confidence_components.notes: Small-N laboratory paradigm, but the manipulation is the point and it is clean. Transfer risk is the prior-language confound, not species or modality.
